newsitem.title: USA: Three US options bourses to list Deutsche Telekom.
newsitem.headline: Three US options bourses to list Deutsche Telekom.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX), Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) and the Pacific Stock Exchange (PSE) said Tuesday they would begin trading options on American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) of Deutsche Telekom AG on February 25.
The exchanges said the options would open with strike prices of 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2, with initial expirations in March, April, July and October.
Shares of the German telecommunications company traded in the U.S. closed at 19-1/8 on Tuesday, down 1/4.
Position limits of 10,500 contracts have been set at the AMEX and the PSE.

At the AMEX, Cohen, Duffy & McGowan Inc has been named specialist. At the CBOE, Kessler Asher has been named the Designated Primary Market Maker (DPM) and at the PSE, the options have been allocated to lead market makers Paul Mandell and William Brandreth of Susquehanna Investment Group.
